fields.title: BRELA search-result record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). BRELA's public Online Registration System (ORS) exposes only a search list -- there is no public detail/drill-down page (directors, shareholders, etc. require a paid 'custom search result' e-service for registered users) -- so every successful record here is one row of the public search-result table, verbatim from upstream's own field names.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact query (name or number) that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: S1-ors-searchresult (a real search-result row) or none (error record).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- not_found (search matched nothing) or blocked_or_transient (network/WAF/timeout issue).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

id.title: Internal ID
id.description: BRELA ORS internal database row ID for this entity (not a public-facing registration number).

last_change_tracking_no.title: Last change tracking number
last_change_tracking_no.description: BRELA's internal filing/transaction tracking code for the most recent change to this record (e.g. G260324-0601).

cert_number.title: Registration / incorporation number
cert_number.description: The public registration number (business names) or incorporation/compliance number (companies) -- the number printed on the certificate.

reg_date.title: Registration date
reg_date.description: Date the business name or company was first registered with BRELA.

incorporation_date.title: Incorporation date
incorporation_date.description: Date of incorporation, for companies (usually null for business names).

legal_name.title: Registered name
legal_name.description: The full registered legal name on file.

subtype_name.title: Subtype (readable)
subtype_name.description: Human-readable entity subtype, e.g. 'Individual', 'Corporation', 'Foreign company', 'Private company Limited by guarantee'.

company_subtype.title: Subtype code
company_subtype.description: BRELA's internal code for subtype_name, e.g. BNT-IND, BNT-CORP, CMP_FRGN, CMP_PRIV_GUAR.

object_type.title: Object type
object_type.description: ET-BUSINESS (business name / sole proprietorship) or ET-COMPANY (company).

ba_category.title: Business activity category code
ba_category.description: BRELA's internal business-activity classification code, where on file.

reg_status.title: Status code
reg_status.description: BRELA's internal status code, e.g. LES-RGC (registered), LES-DIS (dissolved/ceased).

address.title: Address
address.description: Registered address on file, as a single free-text string (region, district, ward, postcode, street).

cess_date.title: Cessation date
cess_date.description: Date the business/company ceased operations or was struck off, if applicable.

update_date.title: Last updated
update_date.description: Timestamp of the last update to this record in the ORS.

has_charges.title: Has registered charges
has_charges.description: Whether the entity has registered charges/liens on file, where indicated by BRELA.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns for each search-result record.
